acceptance: make test-integration exits non-zero when a test writes a new path under go/ outside the allow list
make test-integration on a clean tree passes with its own coverage, bin and rusage outputs present
a regression test plants a leaked .evolve directory and proves the CI target fails
fix: Give evolve treewalk check an allow list of the paths the target itself writes (coverage.*, bin/, the TEST_JSON and TESTRUSAGE_OUT files, runner-samples.ndjson), keep that list in one home in go/Makefile, and run snapshot and check around the test runs in test-integration so that CI and the composed gate fail on the same leak.
routed_reason: backlog review D6 (PR #1571): a lane can build it; no protected path in files[] (first-pass LANE claim, F5.2)
summary: The cycle composed gate runs make test, which has a treewalk guard. CI runs make test-integration, which has no treewalk guard. Three tests leaked .evolve ledgers under go/ (cmd/evolve, internal/core, internal/phases/triage), CI on main stayed green, and every lane composed gate went red (cycle 2419, wave 174: ORCHESTRATOR_COMPOSED_GATE_DECLINED, 4 LEAK paths).
title: CI test-integration runs the treewalk leak guard that make test runs
